input.quote: (b) Each Party's names, trademarks and logos are the exclusive property of said respective Party, and neither Party will acquire any proprietary rights therein by reason of this Agreement or any other agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property ownership provision. The only proprietary-rights language is Section 14(b) (p0065), which addresses names, trademarks and logos only, and the Customer warranty at p0043 that AP owns its Content and Properties — neither states who owns Customer Data (Content, Properties, Inventory and Requests data) or any deliverables/products delivered by Kubient (referenced at p0033 and p0040 with no ownership or licence-back). Nothing assigns AP IP or data to Kubient (so this is not walk-away territory), but the rule expects an ownership clause and none exists, leaving AP's content, audience/inventory data and paid-for deliverables unaddressed. We have inserted a short ownership section: AP retains all rights in its Content, Properties and data; Kubient retains its Auction Platform and pre-existing tools; AP owns deliverables with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any embedded Kubient IP; no joint ownership.

ops.text: 14. Intellectual Property; Customer Data. (a) As between the Parties, Customer owns and retains all right, title and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in and to the Content, the Properties, the Inventory, the Requests and all other data provided by, or collected on behalf of, Customer in connection with the Services (collectively, "Customer Data"). Kubient acquires no right in Customer Data other than a limited, non-exclusive right to use Customer Data solely to provide the Services during the Term. (b) As between the Parties, Kubient owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to the Auction Platform and its pre-existing technology, tools and know-how. (c) Customer shall own all deliverables and work product created for Customer under this Agreement or any Exhibit, and Kubient hereby assigns the same to Customer; to the extent any Kubient pre-existing intellectual property is embedded in such deliverables, Kubient grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense such intellectual property as part of those deliverables. (d) Nothing in this Agreement creates any joint ownership of intellectual property, and the subsequent Section shall be renumbered accordingly.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership provision, so we have added one confirming that AP retains all rights in its Content, Properties and data, that Kubient keeps its Auction Platform and pre-existing tools, and that AP owns (or is licensed to use) any deliverables it pays for, with no joint ownership. This reflects our standard position that we own what we contribute and what we pay for; we can accept a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to deliverables in place of assignment if Kubient prefers.
proposal.summary: Add an IP and Customer Data ownership clause: AP retains its content and data, Kubient retains its platform, AP owns deliverables with licence-back, no joint ownership.
